sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use the chrome_* Chrome DevTools tools to inspect and drive the browser: call chrome_list_pages first, then chrome_take_snapshot to learn element uids, then chrome_click / chrome_fill by uid. Prefer them over guessing page content.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: grep
toolsAdded.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

toolsAdded.name: find
toolsAdded.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

toolsAdded.name: ls
toolsAdded.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

toolsAdded.name: chrome_click
toolsAdded.description:
Clicks on the provided element

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `click` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

dblClick.description: Set to true for double clicks. Default is false.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_close_page
toolsAdded.description:
Closes the page by its index. The last open page cannot be closed.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `close_page` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: The ID of the page to close. Call list_pages to list pages.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_drag
toolsAdded.description:
Drag an element onto another element

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `drag` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

from_uid.description: The uid of the element to drag

to_uid.description: The uid of the element to drop into

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_emulate
toolsAdded.description:
Emulates various features on the target page. Each call replaces all emulation settings (except extraHttpHeaders), so pass all desired settings in a single call.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `emulate` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

networkConditions.description: Throttle network. Omit to disable throttling.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Represents the CPU slowdown factor. Omit or set the rate to 1 to disable throttling

geolocation.description: Geolocation (`<latitude>,<longitude>`) to emulate. Latitude between -90 and 90. Longitude between -180 and 180. Omit to clear the geolocation override.

userAgent.description: User agent to emulate. Omit or set to empty string to clear the user agent override.

colorScheme.description: Emulate the dark or the light mode. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

forcedColors.description: Emulate the `forced-colors` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

prefersContrast.description: Emulate the `prefers-contrast` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

prefersReducedMotion.description: Emulate the `prefers-reduced-motion` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

viewport.description: Emulate device viewports '<width>x<height>x<devicePixelRatio>[,mobile][,touch][,landscape]'. 'touch' and 'mobile' to emulate mobile devices. 'landscape' to emulate landscape mode. Omit to clear the viewport override.

extraHttpHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers as a JSON string object, e.g. {"X-Custom": "value", "Authorization": "Bearer token"}. Headers are included into every HTTP request originating from the page and persist across navigations until cleared. Pass an empty string to clear all extra headers.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_evaluate_script
toolsAdded.description:
Evaluate JavaScript inside the target page. The source can be provided inline or loaded from a local file. Returns the response as JSON, so returned values have to be JSON-serializable.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `evaluate_script` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

function.description:
JavaScript source to execute in the target page. Provide either this or sourcePath, but not both. The source is interpreted according to format.
Example without arguments: `() => document.title` or `async () => await fetch("example.com")`.
Example with arguments: `(el) => el.innerText`

sourcePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a JavaScript file on the MCP server's local filesystem. Provide either this or function, but not both.

format.description: How to interpret the source. "function" treats it as a function declaration and supports args. "script" evaluates it as classic JavaScript and does not support args. Defaults to "function". ECMAScript modules are not supported.

args.description: An optional list of arguments (element uids from the page content snapshot) to pass to the function.

items.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

filePath.description: The absolute or relative path to a file to save the script output to. If omitted, the output is returned inline.

dialogAction.description: Handle dialogs while execution. "accept", "dismiss", or string for response of window.prompt. Defaults to accept.

waitForStableDom.description: Whether to wait for the DOM to settle. Pass false if the script only reads data. Defaults to true.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_fill
toolsAdded.description:
Type text into an input, text area or select an option from a <select> element.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `fill` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

value.description: The value to fill in. "true" or "false" for checkboxes and toggles, "true" for radio buttons.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_fill_form
toolsAdded.description:
Fill out multiple form elements (inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios) at once. ALWAYS prefer this tool over multiple individual 'fill' or 'click' calls when interacting with forms. It is significantly faster, more reliable, and reduces turn count. Example: Fill username, password, and check "Remember Me" in one call.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `fill_form` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of the element to fill out

value.description: Value for the element. "true" or "false" for checkboxes and toggles, "true" for radio buttons.

elements.description: Elements from snapshot to fill out.

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_handle_dialog
toolsAdded.description:
If a browser dialog was opened, use this command to handle it

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `handle_dialog` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

action.description: Whether to dismiss or accept the dialog

promptText.description: Optional prompt text to enter into the dialog.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_hover
toolsAdded.description:
Hover over the provided element

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `hover` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

uid.description: The uid of an element on the page from the page content snapshot

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_list_pages
toolsAdded.description:
Get a list of pages open in the browser.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `list_pages` (server: chrome-devtools).

toolsAdded.name: chrome_navigate_page
toolsAdded.description:
Go to a URL, or back, forward, or reload. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `navigate_page` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

type.description: Navigate the page by URL, back or forward in history, or reload.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to ignore cache on reload.

handleBeforeUnload.description: Whether to auto accept or beforeunload dialogs triggered by this navigation. Default is accept.

initScript.description: A JavaScript script to be executed on each new document before any other scripts for the next navigation.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_new_page
toolsAdded.description:
Open a new tab and load a URL. Use project URL if not specified otherwise.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `new_page` (server: chrome-devtools).

url.description: URL to load in a new page.

background.description: Whether to open the page in the background without bringing it to the front. Default is false (foreground).

isolatedContext.description: If specified, the page is created in an isolated browser context with the given name. Pages in the same browser context share cookies and storage. Pages in different browser contexts are fully isolated (useful for clean-slate testing of cookies and authentication).

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_press_key
toolsAdded.description:
Press a key or key combination. Use this when other input methods like fill() cannot be used (e.g., keyboard shortcuts, navigation keys, or special key combinations).

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `press_key` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

key.description: A key or a combination (e.g., "Enter", "Control+A", "Control++", "Control+Shift+R"). Modifiers: Control, Shift, Alt, Meta

includeSnapshot.description: Whether to include a snapshot in the response. Default is false.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_resize_page
toolsAdded.description:
Resizes the page's window so that the page has specified dimension

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `resize_page` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_select_page
toolsAdded.description:
Select a page as a context for future tool calls.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `select_page` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: The ID of the page to select. Call list_pages to get available pages.

bringToFront.description: Whether to focus the page and bring it to the top.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_take_snapshot
toolsAdded.description:
Take a text snapshot of the target page based on the a11y tree. The snapshot lists page elements along with a unique
identifier (uid). Always use the latest snapshot. Prefer taking a snapshot over taking a screenshot. The snapshot indicates the element selected
in the DevTools Elements panel (if any).

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `take_snapshot` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

verbose.description: Whether to include all possible information available in the full a11y tree. Default is false.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the snapshot to instead of attaching it to the response.

toolsAdded.name: chrome_type_text
toolsAdded.description:
Type text using keyboard into a previously focused input

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `type_text` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

submitKey.description: Optional key to press after typing. E.g., "Enter", "Tab", "Escape"

toolsAdded.name: chrome_wait_for
toolsAdded.description:
Wait for the specified text to appear on the selected page. By default, hidden text is also matched. Set visible to true to wait until the matched text is visible.

Chrome DevTools MCP tool `wait_for` (server: chrome-devtools).

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

text.description: Non-empty list of texts. Resolves when any value appears on the page.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

visible.description: If true, wait until the matching text is visible. By default, hidden text also counts.

                                                uid=5_1051 image "狄仁杰微服潜入幽州，不料一场百姓砸狱竟扯出刺史府的黑幕 #神探狄仁杰#深度解读#电视剧推荐#下饭剧#一个片段看完一整部剧 这一集让我印象最深的，并不是狄仁杰如何识破敌人的阴谋，而是他面对普通百姓时的态度。 前面几集，狄仁杰凭借过人的推理能力，一步步揭开了使团案背后的秘密。而到了幽州，我们又看到了他身上另外一种让人敬佩的品质。 明明已经官复宰相，身负朝廷重任，可面对几个蛮横无理的守城小兵，狄仁杰却没有仗势压人，反而主动赔笑，甚至拿出银子化解冲突。这看似有些窝囊的举动，恰恰体现了他为人处事的高明。因为他很清楚，自己来幽州是为了查案，而不是跟几个小兵争一时的高低。 不过真正让我有所触动的，还是大柳树村百姓的遭遇。 这些普通百姓原本只想守着自己的土地，安安稳稳地过日子。可他们先是遭到突厥人的劫掠，后来又被官府扣上附逆的罪名。好不容易等到朝廷大赦，不仅慰抚款没有拿到，就连赖以生存的土地也被夺走了。最后实在活不下去，才不得不冒险砸狱救人。 可就是这样一群被逼到绝路的百姓，到了方谦嘴里，却成了所谓的暴民。 而狄仁杰最让我佩服的地方，就是他从来没有因为自己正在调查惊天大案，就忽略这些普通人的死活。尤其是他对虎敬晖说出的那句“民生之事，乃朝廷一等一的大事”，更能看出这个人物真正的可贵之处。 一个好官的本事，不只是能查清多少冤案、抓住多少凶手，更重要的是，他能不能真正把百姓放在心上。 所以这一集虽然没有太多惊心动魄的推理，却让我对狄仁杰这个人物有了更深一层的认识。 而结尾那句“暴风雨要来了”，也让我觉得特别应景。幽州表面上看似平静，可官府腐败、百姓蒙冤，背后还有金木兰的势力暗中活动。 狄仁杰这次来到幽州，恐怕不仅要查清使团被杀的真相，还要好好整顿一下这片早已暗流涌动的地方。 这也是我一直喜欢《神探狄仁杰》的原因。狄公之所以让人敬佩，不仅因为他断案如神，更因为他始终没有忘记，自己当官究竟是为了谁。" url="https://p3-pc-sign.douyinpic.com/image-cut-tos/dp_90ee31a0858af479f5ada3dcc03d7f38~tplv-dy-vqe2-sr-opt1:640:480:q80.webp?biz_tag=pcweb_cover&from=327834062&lk3s=138a59ce&s=PackSourceEnum_DOUYIN_WEB_NEW_PAGE&sc=cover&se=false&x-expires=2109304800&x-signature=x7S%2BJwlKvn0z5Lr3sa5mCpKFbos%3D"
